description: This file defines a custom report 'Tax Detail' in the ERPNext system, including report filters, report class with methods for loading, saving, and managing report sections and components, and functions for creating and loading reports.

classes.name: erpnext.TaxDetail
classes.description: Class that manages the 'Tax Detail' report, including patching report methods, loading report data, managing sections and components, and UI controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TaxDetail class, patches report methods, and loads the report.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Monkey patches the existing frappe.query_report methods to override refresh and footer message behavior.

methods.name: show_footer_message
methods.description: Displays footer messages and help info based on report state.

methods.name: refresh_report
methods.description: Refreshes the report, loads custom report data if applicable.

methods.name: load_report
methods.description: Loads report menu items and initializes report UI.

methods.name: get_menu_items
methods.description: Replaces the default menu items with custom save functionality.

methods.name: save_report
methods.description: Saves the current report configuration as a custom report.

methods.name: check_datatable
methods.description: Ensures the datatable is loaded before proceeding.

methods.name: set_section
methods.description: Sets or switches the current report section.

methods.name: reload_component
methods.description: Reloads UI controls for the selected report component.

methods.name: set_table_filters
methods.description: Applies filters to the datatable based on section/component.

methods.name: setAppliedFilters
methods.description: Applies specific filters to the datatable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a section or component from the report configuration.

methods.name: create_controls
methods.description: Creates UI controls for report sections and components.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help information about the report.
